name: lumina-lang
description: A modern functional language with async/await, type inference, and package management

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:dts && npm run build:clean
scripts.build:esm: tsup src/index.ts src/vite-plugin.ts src/lumina-runtime.ts src/bin/lumina.ts src/bin/lumina-lsp.ts src/bin/lumina-repl.ts src/bin/lumina-worker.ts --format esm --clean
scripts.build:cjs: tsup src/index.ts src/lumina-runtime.ts src/bin/lumina-cjs.ts src/bin/lumina-lsp.ts src/bin/lumina-repl.ts src/bin/lumina-worker.ts --format cjs --clean false && node scripts/rename-cjs.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint:check && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test:browser:smoke: node -e "process.env.LUMINA_BROWSER_SMOKE='1'; const cp = require('node:child_process'); const specs = ['tests/browser/smoke/cdn-consumption.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/keyed-hydration.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/opfs.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/playground.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/sab-channel.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/stdlib-browser-modules.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/stdlib-browser.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/wasm-load.spec.ts']; const r = cp.spawnSync('npx', ['playwright', 'test', '--config', 'tests/browser/playwright.config.ts', ...specs], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:browser:benchmark:smoke: node -e "process.env.LUMINA_BROWSER_SMOKE='1'; process.env.LUMINA_DOM_RENDER_BENCHMARK_EXPORT_PATH='.tmp/dom-render-benchmark/export.json'; const cp = require('node:child_process'); const r = cp.spawnSync('npx', ['playwright', 'test', '--config', 'tests/browser/playwright.config.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/dom-render-benchmark.spec.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:browser:benchmark:local: node -e "process.env.LUMINA_BROWSER_SMOKE='1'; process.env.LUMINA_DOM_RENDER_BENCHMARK_TIER='local'; process.env.LUMINA_DOM_RENDER_BENCHMARK_EXPORT_PATH='.tmp/dom-render-benchmark/local-export.json'; const cp = require('node:child_process'); const r = cp.spawnSync('npx', ['playwright', 'test', '--config', 'tests/browser/playwright.config.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/dom-render-benchmark.spec.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:webgpu: node -e "process.env.LUMINA_BROWSER_SMOKE='1'; process.env.LUMINA_WEBGPU_SMOKE='1'; const cp = require('node:child_process'); const r = cp.spawnSync('npx', ['playwright', 'test', '--config', 'tests/browser/playwright.config.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/webgpu-compute.spec.ts', 'tests/browser/smoke/webgpu-render.spec.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:perf:update: node -e "process.env.UPDATE_BASELINE='1'; const cp = require('node:child_process'); const r = cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--no-experimental-webstorage', './node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js', '--config', 'jest.config.cjs', 'tests/wasm-perf-validation.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: false, env: process.env }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.bench: npm run bench:compile && npm run bench:incremental && npm run bench:lsp && npm run bench:runtime && npm run bench:memory && npm run bench:wasm-vs-js && npm run bench:wasm-memory

author: nyigoro
